title: The Vital Point
intro: These surrounded groups have room to make eyes. Look for the point that divides their inside space.

steps.instruction: You are White. Play inside to stop Black making two eyes.
steps.hint: The middle of the three. Not an end.
steps.explanation: White occupies the dividing point. Black can no longer split this space into two secure eyes.

steps.instruction: Now play as Black. Make two eyes before White gets there.
steps.explanation: Black takes the dividing point and makes two eyes. Both sides wanted the same point.

steps.instruction: You are White. Play inside this two-point space.
steps.hint: Either point. There is no vital point here, because there is no room for one.
steps.explanation: This group has too little inside space to make two separate eyes, and no way out.

outro: For each position, check the inside space, the surrounding stones and whose turn it is.
